A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the holonomy of a supersymmetric cycle in a manifold with exceptional holonomy is a subgroup of the holonomy of that manifold, and in the case of Calabi-Yau n-folds, the holonomy of supersymmetric cycles are subgroups of U(n) and SU(n).
